moves.name: Potion
moves.description: Restores an ally’s HP by approximately 40% of its maximum HP.

moves.name: Scintillating Souls Confuse Ray
moves.description: Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once. Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated. Never misses. Leaves all opposing sync pairs confused. Turns the field of play’s zone into a Ghost Zone. (A Ghost Zone powers up Ghost-type attacks.) Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by one rank.

moves.name: History Is Wonderful!
moves.description: Raises the Defense and Sp. Def of all allied sync pairs by four stat ranks. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by one rank. Applies the Damage Guard Next effect to the user.

passives.name: The Explorer of Antiquity
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one the first time it enters a battle each battle. Reduces the sync move countdown by one the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle. Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs when attacking a target that is poisoned or badly poisoned.

passives.name: Paldea Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with the Paldea theme you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.

passives.name: Debut: Ghost S-Tera
passives.description: The user Sync Terastallizes into Ghost type the first time it enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Power of a Deeply Held Grudge
passives.description: When the user’s status move is used and inflicted a status condition on an opponent, inflicts the same status condition on all opposing sync pairs. Lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk by one stat rank when the user’s attack move is successful against targets that are affected by a status condition.

passives.name: Ghost Zone: Team P-Moves & S-Moves DR 2
passives.description: Reduces damage when an ally is hit by an attack move or sync move while the zone is a Ghost Zone.

teraMove.name: Tanzanite Tera Blast
